title: thalictrum minus subsp. foetidum
intro: Thalictrum minus subsp. foetidum, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, gout, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include reducing inflammation, pain, and swelling, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
